My dear [Henrietta](/person/538)

Many thanks to you both for your answers to the Scripture questions, - you see they are beginning to come into the [Monthly Paper](/periodical/81) if you take it in

I hope [Glow Worm](/person/534)'s cold is mending.  Her Gay Geese were quite new to the collections.  I have sent all the Goose answers, though I think [Gurgoyle](/person/327)'s must stand as the best.  I think you will be delighted with the [Barnacle](/periodical/89) it is a very grand one this time.[^1]

I am glad you have answered the Palm Sunday question.  I was afraid no one would.  Some unknown person sent me two nice answers for the two Christmas

&nbsp;

[passage missing where signature has been cut out]

&nbsp;

I shall help out one of your Palm Sunday answers with the other for the [M Paper](/periodical/81).


[^1]: CMY refers to the essay contributions to the [Gosling Society](/topic/104) by Henrietta (\'Irene\'), her sister Charlotte (\'Glow Worm\') and Alice Coleridge (\'Gurgoyle\').
